svg.text: Test card: flat wings and the swift-like outline
MODEL = from our computer model, not a fact. FIRM = follows from symmetry or from the project's own
tests. Whether to bend the trailing edge up, and what drop height to use, are Kai's decisions; this
card recommends neither.
1. Specimens: CG table, mm aft of the root leading edge
F45 (printed, span 250 mm)
CG 36 to 49 mm, 1 mm steps (14 settings)
AVL neutral point with the tip fins: 43.9 mm (outline only, a place to start, not a result)
F60 (printed, span 250 mm)
CG 34 to 44 mm, 1 mm steps (11 settings)
AVL neutral point with the tip fins: 39.6 mm (outline only, a place to start, not a result)
B45 (foamboard, span 400 mm)
CG 57 to 78 mm, 1 mm steps (22 settings)
AVL neutral point with the tip fins: 70.2 mm (outline only, a place to start, not a result)
Stop rule (unchanged): after the table, keep going aft in 1 mm steps while any setting still glides
or still dives. Stop when, after at least one gliding setting, two settings in a row give no steady
glide, or at the bare-aircraft balance point. Releases: 5 per setting, 10 at any setting that
glides. Weigh the glider at each setting.
2. Swift-like outline (bird, version 2)
Tail bend 5 deg, trailing edge UP. Trim CG at lift coefficient 0.3: 26.6 mm (printed, span 250
mm) and 42.6 mm (foamboard, span 400 mm) aft of the root leading edge. MODEL (AVL outline
model): a reference point, not a CG window, not a prediction.
3. Order of tests
a. Weigh every part. Find the CG on a knife edge to 0.5 mm. Check the wing is flat and not twisted.
b. LEVEL HAND GLIDE first: gross trim only. One or two seconds sort a dive from a pitch-up; they
cannot show a repeatable glide.
c. NOSE-DOWN DROP from height: hold it nose straight down, let go at rest. Same height every time.
Height is Kai's decision.
d. Later, quad release (not built yet): hang level, release in forward flight, not from a hover
(FLAT_TEST.md procedure).
Outcome words, exactly: steady glide, dive, pitch-up or stall, pitch oscillation, tumble, roll-off
left, roll-off right, yaw wander.
Sources: FLAT_TEST.md, flat_test_v2 kit tables, bird_outline_v2. Field pack, page 1 of 4.
